summary: The career interview becomes immersive. Talking live opens a voice stage with the question in large type, an orb that grows with the candidate's voice and moves with the interviewer's, and one main button (#2401). The written chat leads with the question being answered, with a Write / Speak switch and one answer bar (#2402), and each topic carries a short title from the record (#2403). Live turns no longer fail on a late microphone frame or an idle recognition stream (#2398, #2399), and the French screens translate the texts the catalogs missed (#2400).
knownLimitations: French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The screening shadow only logs; job-page quarantine still comes from the rules. Live speech and the career interview still need DRAFT_LOOP_SCREENING=rules+model and a Claude key on staging. Topic titles are new: sessions started before this release keep their long reason. The local-first desktop has no career interview.
